name: What is the process for reserving a new construction unit in South Florida?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for reserving a new construction unit in South Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for reserving a new construction unit in South Florida typically begins with a reservation agreement and an initial deposit, which holds the unit while the full purchase contract is prepared. This stage allows you to secure a specific unit and price. Next, you'll review and sign a detailed purchase contract, often followed by a series of additional deposits as construction milestones are met. We can guide you through each step, ensuring you understand the contractual obligations and timelines involved before finalizing your commitment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Reserving a new construction unit involves an initial reservation agreement and deposit, followed by a detailed purchase contract and subsequent milestone deposits.
